reasoning: Experiment 1 explicitly replicates two Yang papers. Experiment 2 tests the specific multi-word preview claim from Cutter and re-tests idiom fixation advantages attributed to three primary eye-tracking papers. Other general idiom, task, model, and preview citations are background rather than separately selected targets. Yang outcomes follow the overall successful verdict despite additional novel composite-region analyses. No original study numbers were specified.
